faq.q: What is an AI TikTok ads generator?
faq.a: It turns a product photo or a product link into a vertical TikTok ad. You can use an [AI actor](/ai-video-generation/ai-actors), a script, and a voice, then edit any of them.

faq.q: How does a product link become a TikTok video?
faq.a: Paste the product page link. The first draft uses the product name and pictures from that page, and it can include a first script. You pick the actor, and you can rewrite any line. You can also upload a photo instead.

faq.q: How quickly can I get a TikTok file?
faq.a: We do not promise how many minutes it takes. You add a link or a photo, pick the actor and the voice, and download. For the first seconds, read [how to make a TikTok ad](/guides/first-tiktok-video-ad).

faq.q: Can I customize the script, actor, and voice?
faq.a: Yes. Rewrite the script, swap the actor, change the voice, and add on-screen words or music in the editor before you publish.

faq.q: What does a TikTok video cost?
faq.a: A video costs 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Credits are what your monthly plan gives you to spend. You see the cost before you start. If a file fails, those credits come back on their own. There is no free plan.

faq.q: Will this choose my TikTok audience?
faq.a: No. You make versions with different scripts, actors, and tones. Who sees the ad, and how much you spend, stay in TikTok Ads Manager. That is TikTok's own screen for ads, not this page. Check TikTok's current rules for AI content on the day you publish.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok from here?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file with no watermark, or send it to TikTok from the editor. You still choose who sees the ad, and the budget, in TikTok Ads Manager.
Yes. Make another file with a different action, language, or line. Each file shows its own credit cost first.

faq.q: Can an AI TikTok ad beat a filmed ad?
faq.a: We do not promise a better result than a filmed ad. You can try more first seconds from the same product without booking another film day.
